title: Can Tech Keep Carrying the Stock Market?
summary: In this IBKR Podcast episode, Andrew Wilkinson is joined by David Keller, President and Chief Strategist at Sierra Alpha Research, to examine whether technology can keep driving the stock market higher as transports and financials struggle. They discuss market breadth, Dow Theory, rising energy costs, the yield curve, and what it could take for the Nasdaq Composite to reach 30,000.
